title: RAW_UNSCREENED: ordered water states with explicit signed exception branches
summary: A finite transition grammar carries one water referent through XI source/removal/cooling/renewal states, then permits marked recipient or condition branches for VII, XIX, and XXXIII sign reversals.

source_clauses_exact: Illa recens in fonte suo sinthomata tollit,
Fonte relicta suo nichil affert utilitatis;
Hec eadem prodest frigida facta parum.
Vim consumendi non habet, unde nocet
design.prediction: State/update order must be recoverable, with sign changes only at explicit recipient or condition boundaries; XI fresh -> removed -> cooled -> renewed is the primary sequence falsifier.
design.nearest_rival: Unordered local effect statements with no state carry or marked branch boundary.
design.falsifier: The source behaves as unordered independent claims, or state/exception boundaries require outcome-first fitting.
assumption_costs: Repeated water references may share a source referent.
No target word or medical efficacy is inferred.
design.scope_note: Source-only raw grammar; no target endpoint or test selected.
